title: Skin is the outer barrier against drying, infection, and injury
summary: OpenStax says skin is the first defense against drying, infection, and injury to the rest of the body.
body: OpenStax says skin is the first defense against drying, infection, and injury to the rest of the body. An outer epidermis and a deeper dermis make up that defense. This card is the barrier job. Rashes are a different topic. The wording is a paraphrase of the integument chapter.

sources.title: 5.3 Functions of the Integumentary System, chapter review
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology, first edition, web view, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase: skin is the first defense against dehydration, infection, and injury. Epidermis and dermis are named in section 5.1 of the same review.
